lineSrc: published 18Birdies hole route (korthalsbanan-routes.geojson), tee end slid to the card Gul length
conf: provisional: routing from published GPS routes, shapes synthesised, card lengths unconfirmed
note: Veckefjärdens GC korthålsbana, nine par 3s. Environment shared verbatim with the Mästerskapsbanan (geobuild/course-model.json), INCLUDING its penalty marking, its silt shallows and the regulated lake level of 21.59 m; the eighteen is carried here as scenery. Routing from published GPS routes; lengths from a card that does not reconcile with its own printed totals (see card-korthalsbanan.json). Greens, fairways and tee pads are synthesised and marked prov:"synth".
